title: hostResourceLimits
responsibility: Reads hierarchical Linux cgroup-v2 CPU and memory quotas without treating host capacity as container capacity.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to inspect cgroup-v2 limits on Linux; it defaults to /sys/fs/cgroup and can point to a fixture tree.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.membership
inputs.description: Proc cgroup membership file used to locate this process in the cgroup-v2 hierarchy; it defaults to /proc/self/cgroup.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.system
inputs.description: Operating system identifier used to decide whether to read Linux cgroup files; defaults to platform(), and any value other than "linux" returns an empty HostLimits object.

outputs.name: hostResourceLimits
outputs.description: On Linux, contains the tightest cgroup-v2 CPU and memory limits found from the process cgroup through visible ancestors; fields are omitted when no finite quota is reported. On other platforms it is an empty object.

errors.name: HostResourceLimitsError
errors.description: Throws Error with messages 'Resource admission requires cgroup v2 on Linux', 'Cannot establish cgroup membership', 'Invalid cgroup path', 'Invalid CPU quota', or 'Invalid memory quota' when those checks fail. Filesystem read errors for membership, selected cpu.stat, memory.current, or non-ENOENT cpu.max and memory.max reads also propagate.
